title: French-Style Eggplant Tagine
description: A flavorful French-inspired dish made with eggplant, algerian spices, and lush fresh herbs.
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and algerian spices.
Add the eggplant cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the eggplant mixture to a baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the eggplant is tender.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat.
Add the lush fresh herbs and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the pea to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
To assemble the tagine, place the cooked eggplant mixture in the center of a plate.
Top with the pea and lush herb mixture.
